story_scene: Level 901 (菲納斯河畔伏擊): winfail010's win section rearms big-map point 8 with
actBMSetPointEvent 8,901,bmpmGeneral, so reaching 菲納斯河畔 after the ruins battle
opens this ambush instead of the level 8 story scene. No shape of its own — the
seed aliases the level 8 riverside map (obj-901.obs 地圖管理員 names LEVEL08.SHP,
the WRD is level 8's byte for byte). The five-member party walks in from the
north edge, the Wosfita captain 024 (fourteen 023 and three 024 wait on both
banks) calls out the traitor and 雷歐納德 answers; WORD901 (狙兵) is shown. The
winfail901 body (round-8 arrivals of 031 / 027 / 030, the 琥-vs-031 exchange,
the 席達鎮 town rewrites) is not remade; the preview stops at first control.
STORY901 opens on actPlayLevelMusic; the original resolver 0x42c1c0 returns -1
for any level >= 100 (static-derived, original_world_town.md), so the music
table names no track for 901 and actPlayLevelMusic changes nothing (original_music.md).
Back to the big map standing at 菲納斯河畔 (point 8); the skip_battle row offers
winfail901's win section (point 8 -> Visit / ratio 20, the 席達鎮 town event
